days.title: Midtown — street photography or MoMA
days.thesis: Individual waypoints in walking order. Morning is flexible; choose the afternoon photography route OR MoMA. Evening loop is optional.

notes: Allow roughly three hours for the morning route, including stops; timing is flexible.
stops.photo: Suggested departure around 09:30; walk south to West 44th Street.

notes: Continue south on Sixth Avenue to 41st Street.
stops.photo: Head east along 44th toward Sixth Avenue. Look for theater entrances, deliveries and people moving between bright avenues and quieter streets.

notes: Suggested pause about 30 minutes; continue around the library to Fifth Avenue.
stops.photo: Enter the park and linger along the tree-lined paths: solitary figures, chair patterns and layers through foliage.

notes: Continue north to 42nd Street, then east.
stops.photo: Work the library exterior and steps for waiting figures, gestures and passing buses.

notes: Follow promising frames rather than rushing to the terminal.
stops.photo: Walk east toward Vanderbilt Avenue, working storefront reflections, overlapping signs and pedestrians.

notes: Handheld personal noncommercial photography is allowed; commercial work or professional equipment may require permission. Lunch location remains open.
stops.photo: Finish with people moving against the terminal architecture; explore the Main Concourse if appropriate.

notes: Photography route is an ALTERNATIVE to MoMA, not an additional commitment. Allow two to three hours for all afternoon waypoints; shorten freely.
stops.photo: After lunch, head west on 45th Street toward Madison Avenue. Look for window layers and people framed by entrances.

notes: Part of the optional photography route instead of MoMA.
stops.photo: Head north toward 49th Street. Pause at shop windows and cross streets for reflections and pedestrians.

notes: Part of the photography alternative. Use public pedestrian routes and observe posted site rules.
stops.photo: Turn west toward Fifth Avenue and Rockefeller Center, watching for figures against architectural lines.

notes: Continue north toward 53rd Street when ready; part of the photography alternative.
stops.photo: Explore the plaza area for entrances, repeating lines and pedestrian movement.

notes: End the optional route here or return via Sixth Avenue and 45th Street toward the hotel.
stops.photo: Head west toward Sixth Avenue, photographing street life and windows. MoMA is nearby if your mood changes.

notes: Regular Monday hours checked September 17: 10:30–17:30. No ticket booked; exhibitions and visit length remain open.
stops.photo: Choose a museum visit instead of the afternoon photography route if it appeals.

notes: Entire evening loop is optional, roughly 60–90 minutes, depending on energy, weather and plans with Debbie.

notes: Continue west along 47th; no assumption of step access.

notes: Return toward the Broadway plazas when ready.

days.title: East Village, Lower East Side and Chinatown
days.thesis: Draft shooting day centered on Chris's favorite neighborhoods, with plenty of unstructured walking time.

notes: Suggested start around 10:00; allow three to four hours including pauses and lunch. This is one continuous flexible route, represented as individual items until nested routes are supported.
stops.photo: Walk east along St. Marks toward Avenue A. Look for storefront layers, lettering, stoops and figures framed by entrances.

notes: Stay as long as the scene holds your attention; continue west along 7th Street.
stops.photo: Explore the park paths for benches, gestures and layers through trees; leave at Avenue A and East 7th Street.

notes: At First Avenue turn south toward Houston Street.
stops.photo: Walk west toward First Avenue, watching windows, small entrances and quieter street compositions.

notes: At Houston turn west to Orchard Street, then cross at the marked crossing to head south on Orchard.
stops.photo: Follow First Avenue south, using intersections for moving figures and contrasting backgrounds.

notes: No fixed subject list; follow the light and activity.
stops.photo: Continue south on Orchard toward Rivington, lingering over storefronts, fire escapes and the mix of older and newer facades.

notes: This loop returns to Orchard for the southbound continuation.
stops.photo: Turn east on Rivington to Ludlow, south on Ludlow to Delancey, then west to Orchard. Look for windows, signs and people at street corners.

notes: The Tenement Museum visitor center is a location anchor, not a booked museum stop. Cross Delancey at the pedestrian crossing.
stops.photo: Photograph the surrounding streetscape, then continue south on Orchard toward Broome.

notes: Chinatown route is still to be detailed. ICP remains optional; no requirement to stop shooting.
stops.photo: Finish this route here, with lunch wherever appeals. Continue south toward Grand Street for the Chinatown block, or east along Broome toward Ludlow for ICP.

notes: ⚠ REVIEW: Sequence with the Lower East Side and any museum stop remains flexible.
stops.photo: Continue the neighborhood exploration, with time for storefront details and street life.
